_readme: Roster for the local-company news feed (replaces the old Yahoo ticker firehose). Expert-editable: add/remove companies or flip 'active' here. Only entities with a confirmed working source are active:true so the feed never implies coverage it doesn't have. Source types: yahoo_search (public co, by ticker), wire_page (PR Newswire company page), rss (native feed), html_scrape (server-rendered newsroom). Region is the Philadelphia 8-county core. National tier names (FanDuel, Amazon, etc.) are intentionally excluded — topical, not local.

entities.name: Wawa
entities.note: PRN page is sparse; promos route via GlobeNewswire. Add wawa.com html_scrape for fuller coverage.
